import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set working directories
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))

# Create submission template if it doesn't exist
sample_sub_dir = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")
if os.path.exists(sample_sub_dir):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_dir)
    col_names = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
else:
    col_names = ["prediction"]

print(f"Train samples: {len(train_df)}, Test samples: {len(test_df)}")


def extract_features(text):
    """Extract basic statistical features from text."""
    try:
        text = str(text).strip() if isinstance(text, str) else ""
        if not text:
            return np.zeros(10)

        text_clean = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ").lower()
        length = len(text_clean)
        word_chars = sum(1 for c in text_clean if c.isalnum())
        special_chars = sum(
            1 for c in text_clean if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace()
        )
        numeric_content = sum(1 for c in text_clean if c.isdigit())
        tokens = [w.strip() for w in text_clean.split() if w.strip()]
        num_tokens = max(len(tokens), 1)

        avg_word_len = np.mean([len(w) for w in tokens]) if tokens else 0
        max_word_len = max(len(w) for w in tokens) if tokens else 0
        upper_words = sum(1 for w in tokens if w[0].isupper())
        all_upper_ratio = upper_words / num_tokens
        exclamation = sum(1 for w in tokens if w.endswith("!"))
        question_mark = sum(1 for w in tokens if w.endswith("?"))

        punctuation_total = exclamation + question_mark
        whitespace_count = sum(1 for c in text_clean if c.isspace())
        whitespace_ratio = whitespace_count / length if length > 0 else 0

        consecutive_spaces = 0
        for i in range(1, min(len(text_clean), 10)):
            if text_clean[i].isspace() and text_clean[i - 1].isspace():
                consecutive_spaces += 1

        # Character frequency features
        char_freq = {}
        for c in text_clean:
            char_freq[c] = char_freq.get(c, 0) + 1

        most_common_char = max(
            char_freq.keys(), key=lambda x: char_freq[x], default=None
        )
        char_diversity = len(set(text_clean)) / length if length > 0 else 0

        # Special patterns
        bigram_patterns = ["!!", "??", "!!!", "????", "&&", "####", "--", "---"]
        pattern_matches = sum(text_clean.count(p) for p in bigram_patterns)

        # Word level features
        negative_words = [
            "idiot",
            "stupid",
            "dumb",
            "loser",
            "fag",
            "retard",
            "bastard",
            "wanker",
            "twat",
            "bullshit",
            "fuck",
            "asshole",
            "bitch",
            "idiotic",
        ]
        positive_words = ["great", "amazing", "awesome", "good", "best", "love"]
        neg_word_count = sum(1 for w in tokens if any(nw in w for nw in negative_words))
        pos_word_count = sum(1 for w in tokens if any(pw in w for pw in positive_words))

        return np.array(
            [
                length,
                word_chars,
                special_chars,
                numeric_content,
                whitespace_count,
                whitespace_ratio,
                num_tokens,
                avg_word_len,
                max_word_len,
                consecutive_spaces,
                pattern_matches,
                neg_word_count,
                pos_word_count,
                char_diversity,
                most_common_char,
                all_upper_ratio,
                exclamation,
                question_mark,
                punctuation_total,
            ]
        )
    except Exception:
        return np.zeros(19)

y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(float)

)
